Cadre AI is an AI strategy and implementation firm that helps you move "From AI Confusion to AI Confidence." We help you pinpoint the right AI opportunities, implement them seamlessly, and deliver real business impact—focused on driving revenue growth and improving EBITDA.

We work department by department to identify and implement AI workflows and agents that unlock real ROI. Our approach is simple: **Find. Prepare. Implement.** We don't just hand you slides and walk away—we train your team how to use AI effectively, when to rely on it, and when to lead without it.

We've delivered high-ROI use cases across 50+ companies, and we're an official OpenAI Service Partner and Anthropic partner.

Want to talk through how this could work for your business? You can [talk to an AI Strategist](https://cadre.ai/) or reach us at hello@gocadre.ai.

Cadre offers four core services:

- **AI Strategy** — The AI Transformation Intensive, a 45-day program that takes you from zero clarity to a prioritized roadmap your team can execute, with ROI estimates and a 3-year plan.
- **AI Leadership & Facilitation** — We transform executives and teams from AI-hesitant to AI-ambitious through formats like 2-Day Leadership Intensives, 1-Day Workshops, Half-Day Executive Sessions, and 1-Hour Virtual Kickoffs.
- **AI Engineering** — We connect your systems, automate workflows, and multiply impact by solving problems with the right combination of existing tools, smart automation, and custom AI agents (automating things like data entry, document routing, email triage, and report generation).
- **AI Agents** — We help you build everything from simple prompts and assistants to full AI agents, including voice agents that handle intake, qualification, support, and internal routing with guardrails and human oversight.
